ADC_ACTION_PARAM_VISUAL_TYPES

Table to store how a parameter type has to be displayed.

Columns
capvt_id

PK, technical key

capvt_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

capvt_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, Fixed value ADC

capvt_param_item_extension

Extension for the parameter item on the page. Distinguishes the different types.

capvt_sort_seq

Sort criteria

capvt_active

Flag to indicate whether visual type is in use

References

capvt_pti_id, capvt_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg)
